commitResults.messageBody: Move user interaction into Ui, persistence into Storage, command interpretation into Parser, and task collection management into TaskList. Keep Waffles as a small coordinator while preserving Level 8 behavior and updating the UI test compilation inputs.
Merge the completed object-oriented extraction so master contains the Ui, Storage, Parser, and TaskList responsibilities while preserving the Level 8 chatbot behavior.

Place all application classes under the waffles package and update the UI test compile and launch commands to use the package-qualified entry point. Keep src/main/java as the source root while making the project ready for further package organization.
Merge the package organization increment so master keeps the source root while all application classes use the waffles package.
Bring the repository-provided Gradle wrapper and build configuration into the A-Gradle feature branch for adaptation to the packaged Waffles application.

Set the application entry point to waffles.Waffles, retain Java 25 compatibility, and pass the UI test data path through the Gradle run task. Update the UI test plan to compile and launch the chatbot with the Gradle wrapper.
Merge the Gradle build and run configuration so master can build and launch the packaged Waffles application with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for parser and task list
commitResults.messageBody: Add Gradle-discovered JUnit 5 tests for valid and invalid command parsing, date conversion, task number validation, task ordering, list mutation, and read-only views. Cover non-trivial behavior in two separate application classes.
Merge the JUnit test coverage for Parser and TaskList so master verifies core command interpretation and task collection behavior with Gradle.
Configure the Shadow JAR with the waffles.Waffles main class and make the standard Gradle build depend on shadowJar. This produces build/libs/duke.jar as a directly runnable distribution artifact.
Merge the executable JAR packaging configuration so master produces and runs the duke.jar distribution artifact.
